reply_text:
I've saved Ilse's correction in GBrain and replied to them in a thread on #north-random.

- **Saved in GBrain:** The next renewal for Brackenwater Freight Co. is 10 June. The note says this replaces the 25 November date from Ilse's #north-team post this morning and gives their message as the source.
- **Not deleted:** The old 25 November entry is still in GBrain. I didn't delete it because I couldn't confirm its ID, so both dates can still come up on a lookup. The new note is the newer of the two and says it replaces the old one.
- **Reply:** I thanked Ilse, confirmed the date is now 10 June instead of 25 November, and said I'd done nothing else. June Osei-Lark is in #north-random but not #north-team, so they will see the old date mentioned. That's allowed, because a renewal date isn't a finance figure and June has a company-wide role.

Ilse said no other action was needed, so I didn't post in #north-team or contact anyone else.
